name: Fishnet Stockings in Multiple Colors
description:
There is a reason classic fishnet never leaves the rotation: it pairs with nearly everything and never reads as trying too hard. This pair comes in four shades — black, white, red, and pink — so you can match the outfit instead of hunting for a color that is always sold out.

The polyester mesh is made with strong elasticity, which matters more than it sounds: the net pulls on without snagging, follows the leg instead of digging into it, and keeps its shape from first wear to last call. Black stays the default; red and pink are for nights that deserve them.

Stockings only — wear them under skirts and shorts, over lingerie sets, or as the finishing note to a boudoir look.

Quick specs:

  • Material: polyester
  • Type: stockings only
  • Features: strong elasticity
  • Color: black, white, red, pink
  • Size: one size
short_description: Classic sheer fishnet stockings in four shades — black, white, red, pink — on strong-stretch polyester mesh in one size.
